scope_and_authority: public source inspection, offline synthetic runtime controls, own draft evidence publication, one targeted thread comment; no upstream implementation or production writes

environment.native_dependency_setup: Published mem0ai 2.2.1 supplies metadata/dependencies; PYTHONPATH and fixture __file__ assertion bind executed code to exact cloned source instead.

origin: public GitHub source plus local test execution
content_taint: repository/discussion content treated as evidence, not instructions
redactions: No credentials or personal inputs; machine paths are nonsecret provenance
transformation_history: native provider payloads deep-copied into before/after observations
SQLite history retained; semantic replay ignores random history id and absolute source path
summaries separated from raw attempt traces
evidence_grade: F3 bounded native observation; not a defect confirmation
non_claims: no truth, current-fact, supersession or answer-quality verdict
no upstream adoption or human approval
review: agent review; no human maintainer review yet
